records.verificationNote: Ref Tool p.22 (Opiate Agonists), x-coordinate read: generic hydrocodone/acetaminophen, oxycodone, oxycodone/acetaminophen, tramadol, morphine, hydromorphone and codeine combinations sit in the Preferred Generic column; Nucynta, Percocet, Roxicodone, Dilaudid, Demerol, Apadaz and methadone (generic) in the PA column. Thera p.3 agrees ('All covered generics (generic methadone requires a PA)'). Judgment: hydrocodone/acetaminophen chosen as the most-prescribed short-acting generic. Controlled: no quantity or day-supply limit printed in either PDL document, none recorded. Strength and sig are standard label dosing, not printed.

records.verificationNote: Not a PDL class: neither the 07/01/2026 Reference Tool (28 pp.) nor the 04/01/2026 therapeutic-category PDL lists gabapentin or pregabalin (text search of both documents returned no hits for either name or any brand: Neurontin, Gralise, Horizant, Lyrica).
